paragraphs: Rav Yechiel: Rabbi Achli, some say Rav Yechiel, Eruvin 12a. There, 31b: the presumption that an agent performs his commission. There, 28b and 77a; Beitzah 14b; Moed Katan 10a. In Rav Chisda’s time: Beitzah, chapter 1. Rabbah bar Yonatan said: Rabbi Yechiel said, Yoma 47a and Nedarim, chapter 4, 41b.
